name: Armilla AI
long_description: Armilla AI (YC W22) is the first YC-backed MGA and Lloyd's Coverholder dedicated to insuring AI-related risks. Armilla's insurance policies cover developers and deployers of generative AI and AI agents for performance and liability -- from errors and hallucinations, to incorrect decisions, data leakage, regulatory violations and more.
one_liner: Liability insurance for generative AI and AI Agents

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Karthik is the President and Chief Business Officer for Armilla AI. He previously led go-to-market teams at Element AI as VP. He led the AI  solutions and strategy for financial institutions and regulators globally. Previously he co-founded Blu Trumpet (CTO) and Gallop Labs (CEO). At Deloitte, he helped set up the global product factory and AI offerings. He has authored and published one of the widely cited whitepapers on Fairness evaluation of AI models and AI Enterprise strategy.
